candidates.headline: Rookie Caleb Douglas atop Dolphins WR depth chart for preseason opener
candidates.description: Miami's thin wide receiver room created an opportunity for Caleb Douglas to make an early impact, which he has done so far.

candidates.headline: Sources: Facing charges, Terrion Arnold set to join Seahawks
candidates.description: Terrion Arnold, who sources told NFL Network plans to sign a one-year deal with the Seahawks, also had visited the Texans, Saints and Giants before choosing the Seahawks.

candidates.headline: Jerry Jones: Very happy with Cowboys post-Micah Parsons trade
candidates.description: Jerry Jones likened the Micah Parsons deal to the 1989 trade of running back Herschel Walker to the Vikings that helped build the Cowboys' dynasty of the 1990s.
